hook: Roland Busch has been President and CEO of Siemens AG since February 2021, after thirty-two years at the company. He is a physicist by training, with a doctorate in high-temperature superconductivity from FAU Erlangen-Nurnberg, and he began at Siemens in corporate research working on fuel cells, offshore wind, photovoltaics and superconducting transmission lines. That background matters to how Siemens frames AI: the company combines what it calls the real and digital worlds, which is a different problem from text generation. Industrial AI runs against physical assets with safety consequences and decades-long service lives, and it has to be verifiable in a way a chat interface does not.
name: Roland Busch

quote.text: I believe technology is the most powerful tool humanity has.

Leads technology strategy through the build-out of the digital portfolio

timeline.event: Becomes President and CEO of Siemens AG in February

timeline.event: Appears on the Dreamforce main keynote stage with the CEOs of Salesforce, NVIDIA and Anthropic

quick_facts: President and CEO of Siemens AG since February 2021
Thirty-two years at Siemens, joining corporate research and development in 1994
Member of the Managing Board since 2011 and Chairman of Siemens Mobility since 2019
Served as Chief Technology Officer from 2016 to 2020 and Chief Operating Officer from 2018 to 2019
PhD in high-temperature superconductivity physics, FAU Erlangen-Nurnberg
Chairman of the Asia-Pacific Committee of German Business since 2021
Supervisory board member at Munich Re since 2024

achievements.title: Leading Siemens through the industrial AI transition
achievements.impact: Has run the group since 2021 as it positioned AI-powered technology across smart factories, infrastructure, transport and healthcare rather than as a standalone product line.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, 2016 to 2020
achievements.impact: Held the CTO role during the period Siemens built out its digital twin and industrial software portfolio, then took the top job.

achievements.title: Early research in energy technology
achievements.impact: Began at Siemens corporate research in 1994 on fuel cells, offshore wind, photovoltaics and high-temperature superconducting transmission lines, the physical systems AI is now applied to.
